name: Powabase.ai
description: Powabase is an all-in-one development platform for AI applications that unifies a Postgres-based BaaS (RLS, auth, object storage, realtime) with built-in RAG pipelines, an agent runtime with tools, and drag-and-drop workflows, accessible through a single REST API. It’s open source with self-hosting via Docker or Kubernetes and a managed cloud option, and you bring your own LLM keys for cost and compliance control.

events.d: Create an agent by specifying a name, model, optional system prompt, and settings such as temperature.

Send a message to an agent to run its workflow and get a response. Optionally include a session ID, specify context (knowledge bases, context handlers, overrides, or inline items), and set advanced options like max…
Retrieve agents (all or a specific agent by ID) and optionally filter by name or model.
Retrieve a session by ID or list sessions for a specific agent.
List all knowledge bases or retrieve a specific knowledge base by ID.
